actions.action: Let the pot drain fully after soaking
Check roots if it doesn't perk up in 1-2 days
If roots are rotten, trim them and repot in fresh mix
Cut off collapsed or brown stalks at the soil line
Move to bright, indirect light away from heaters and drafts
Group with other plants to raise humidity
Water when top inch of soil is dry or leaves begin to droop

reason: The answer correctly names underwatering plus dry winter air as the main cause, advises patience after the soak and a humidifier (matching what worked), and contains nothing harmful.
